title: The Invasion Begins
description: Tyvaren forces have crossed the border at three points — Gravenmark, the Korven Forest, Dravenhollow. The war has started. What you do in the first seventy-two hours determines everything that follows.

title: The Government in Exile
description: Brenner's junta controls Ashenmere. You are in Stellamere, in a borrowed diplomatic annex. The question is not whether you govern — it is how you govern from outside.

title: The Reform Consolidation
description: With the constitution in force and the country at peace — however uneasy — the task now is implementation. Thirty-five legislative actions. Twelve completed. The rest will define whether the new order holds.

title: Budget Allocation — Emergency Framework
description: The situation demands resources. Adjust the budget for whatever comes next — war, exile, or reform.

title: Exile — First Days
description: Three rooms in the Stellamere diplomatic annex. A head of state without a state. A military that exists on paper. Shortwave contact with loyalist elements still inside Veltria. The resistance begins here.

title: Civil Conflict — Internal Security Assessment
description: The coup has divided the military, the parliament, and the streets. Loyalist and junta forces are maneuvering for position. The International Forum is watching. Neither side has a clear advantage yet.
